description: Instruction-intent texts for the text_intent person-FP ablation (paper §9.8). Each text is a command/prompt (zh + en) carrying a name-shaped token (surname+given char / title+surname) behind a context prefix, with NO real person PII — so every `person` detection on these is a false positive. The command framing classifies the text as text_intent="instruction", which raises the L1b person threshold (0.8 → 1.2) and suppresses the token. The leading command clause ends at the first ， / : delimiter so the harness can derive a non-instruction (suppression-off) frame by taking the body after it.
